properties.description:
MEASURED, not argued, on music_graph's real committed export (327 nodes / 939 edges, store built under 0.20.0, both fields added later in v0.24.0 and never backfilled).

THE DEFECT: `default:` in the schema YAML is executed by dynograph-core at WRITE time (schema.rs:507 inserts any missing property that declares one), so importing an export MATERIALISED `granularity: atomic` and `volatility: stable` onto every Artifact the document honestly said nothing about. Their restore, walking the run-book's own §0b procedure on a fresh clone with no design work at all: `--diff` of the imported file against the store it had just built reported design_changed 35 of 35 Artifacts, edges_changed 0, content hash d10d80da -> cef7db52, and the pre-commit hook blocked a commit on a machine where nobody had designed anything.

MEASURED HERE, BOTH DIRECTIONS, through import -> re-export on their real file: as shipped, 35 nodes came back different, gaining exactly Artifact.granularity and Artifact.volatility; with the two `default:` tokens removed, 0 nodes changed and nothing was invented. The real gate agrees — `reflow2_check.py` against their export went from 5 findings including ROUND TRIP to 4, the remaining four being their own genuine artifact drift, which they can fix honestly.

⭐ WHY THIS ROUTE AND NOT THE THREE THEY PROPOSED. The reader ALREADY supplies the safe reading: coverage.rs:209 `.unwrap_or("atomic")` and drift.rs:436 `.unwrap_or("stable")`. So the schema default was redundant with the code — it changed no report's verdict and bought nothing, while costing the round trip. Their (a) backfill-on-import writes values nobody chose into every consumer store permanently; their (b) exclude-defaults-from-the-hash is the route cap:defaults-are-not-serialized argues CANNOT work, because absence would come to mean "nobody said OR somebody chose the default", and it would weaken the hash for the 71 properties that legitimately keep defaults; their (c) print-what-was-defaulted leaves the gate red and the restore broken and only explains it. Anthony chose the fourth.

⚠️ THIS REVERSES A DELIBERATE BL-198 KEEP, on his word, and the earlier reasoning was not wrong: `stable` IS the safe reading. What changed is the measurement that the safe reading already lives in the reader. tests/schema_defaults.rs asserted `schema_default("Artifact","granularity") == Some("atomic")`; it now asserts None, and the declared-defaults floor moves 71 -> 69.

FORWARD-ONLY, so nothing already written moves: reflow2's own Artifacts keep the values they hold, its export does not churn, and its own round trip stays clean (verified — no ROUND TRIP finding on docs/design/reflow2.json). music_graph's store has no values to keep, which is exactly why their case comes out clean.

NOT ESTABLISHED, and stated rather than discovered later: how many other consumer designs predate v0.24.0; whether any OTHER node type carries the same unbackfilled shape (the same defect would be invisible until someone restores); and F24, the latent-surface-never-re-probes finding, sits on the same restore path and is NOT addressed here.
properties.name: Artifact.granularity and .volatility stop declaring schema defaults, so an old export stops gaining two properties nobody chose on every import (music_graph F23)
